I have added serialization support (`Encode` and `Decode`) to [`ShapeIndex`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_3vnrs6i/s2/shapeindex.go#L1553-L1757) and all built-in [`Shape`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_3vnrs6i/s2/shape.go#L186) types.

### Summary of Changes

1. **`ShapeIndex` Serialization**:
   - Implemented [`Encode(w io.Writer) error`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_3vnrs6i/s2/shapeindex.go#L1553) and [`Decode(r io.Reader) error`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_3vnrs6i/s2/shapeindex.go#L1609) on `ShapeIndex`.
   - `Encode` automatically triggers pending updates (`maybeApplyUpdates()`) prior to encoding, so even unbuilt indexes are fully encoded.
   - Preserves `nextID` and shape IDs so references within spatial index cells remain valid across round-trips.
   - Encodes and restores the full spatial cell hierarchy (`cellMap`, `cells`, `clippedShape`s, `containsCenter` flags, and edge IDs), enabling queries and iteration immediately after `Decode` without calling `Build()`.
   - Empty indexes serialize to a valid, non-empty byte stream containing version and index metadata.

2. **Built-in `Shape` Types Round-Trip Support**:
   - Added `Encode` and `Decode` methods and assign non-zero `typeTag` values to all built-in shape types:
     - [`Polygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_3vnrs6i/s2/polygon.go) (`typeTagPolygon`)
     - [`Polyline`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_3vnrs6i/s2/polyline.go) (`typeTagPolyline`)
     - [`PointVector`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_3vnrs6i/s2/point_vector.go#L44-L90) (`typeTagPointVector`)
     - [`LaxPolyline`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_3vnrs6i/s2/lax_polyline.go#L56-L102) (`typeTagLaxPolyline`)
     - [`LaxPolygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_3vnrs6i/s2/lax_polygon.go#L223-L297) (`typeTagLaxPolygon`)
     - [`Loop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_3vnrs6i/s2/loop.go#L521) (`typeTagLoop`)
     - [`LaxLoop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_3vnrs6i/s2/lax_loop.go#L87-L134) (`typeTagLaxLoop`)
   - Fully supports round-tripping zero-edge shapes (e.g. empty point vectors, empty polylines, empty/full polygons) and shapes with mixed chain counts.

3. **Input Validation and Error Handling**:
   - Added guard checks against malformed input, including truncated data streams, corrupted bytes/tags, invalid shape/edge ID references, and oversized allocation requests.

4. **Git Branch & Commits**:
   - Worked on a new branch [`shapeindex-serialization`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_3vnrs6i) created from `master` and committed all changes.
